newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Small blast in East Jerusalem, one slightly injured.
newsitem.headline: Small blast in East Jerusalem, one slightly injured.

text.p: Israeli police said on Thursday a small bomb exploded at an Interior Ministry office in Arab East Jerusalem, injuring one Arab woman slightly and causing light damage.

The police said concussion from the blast at the entrance to the office had injured the woman's ears. They said damage was caused to a door of the office. Police closed the street in front of the office and began searches.
